indexes.scope: All 79 chapter identities of the 2023-02-09 CSC Models Manual for Elmer 9.0, as posted by editor Peter Råback. Each normalized title is independently cross-referenced to its corresponding bookmark in the 2026-01-20 CSC mirror PDF.
indexes.limitations: The official CSC URL is rolling. Its indexed June 2024 edition stated Elmer 9.0 and listed all 79 titles in order. The directly retrieved PDF states Elmer 26.1 and adds a chapter at position 67; its PDF bookmarks corroborate titles and order only. Its parameters are not evidence for Elmer 9.0. The public manuals repository at the verified historical commit does not provide Models Manual LaTeX. Optional, obsolete and contributed models are subject to independent release-source verification.

indexes.scope: Fixed 9.0 static typed SIF keyword declarations plus MATC-generated numbered families.
indexes.limitations: The dictionary is a declaration/keyword inspection index and is not a complete list of module-private or composed SIF settings. A numbered family is indexed once by template. Comments are excluded.

indexes.scope: Unique library + routine pairs in literal Procedure declarations across fixed 9.0 fem/tests and fem/examples SIF decks.
indexes.limitations: Bundled test/example evidence only. An unexercised module procedure may not appear. A custom test routine is not automatically a public built-in solver.

indexes.scope: Reviewed composite workflows from pinned Elmer 9.0 test input.
indexes.limitations: This index distinguishes composite chained configurations from single procedure names. Current entries are the audited coupled cases.

indexes.scope: 固定版 fem/src/modules 内直接读取、且未计入 SOLVER.KEYWORDS 字典的字面量 SIF 参数；按大小写无关的参数名称去重。
indexes.limitations: 覆盖可还原的常量名 Get/ListGet 调用；运行时拼接名、非直接调用、自定义模块及载入后额外参数未穷举。名称的出现不足以证明已配置或求解。

indexes.scope: 按目标版本核验的特定模块、输出或运行模式限制，逐条链接原始依据。
indexes.limitations: 每项仅针对明确指出的实现和目标版本；其他方法或自定义扩展另行评估。
